jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.why: Excellent early-career operations and systems match in advertising technology. The role supports revenue data, reporting, processes and systems, partners cross-functionally, and translates business information into clear insights. Audrey's media background plus business systems and operations experience gives her a particularly relevant angle.
jobs.gap: The role has an analytics emphasis, so Audrey should foreground Excel/reporting, CRM or Salesforce work, data quality, dashboards and examples of turning operational data into decisions.

jobs.title: Salesforce Engineer I
jobs.why: Strong Salesforce/business-systems opportunity with a junior-level title. The work includes maintaining and enhancing Salesforce, reports and dashboards, documentation, user training, integrations and workflow improvement, all of which connect well to Audrey's Salesforce and business-analysis experience.
jobs.gap: This is more technical than a typical Business Analyst role. The posting asks for hands-on integrations/APIs, custom development or data migration experience and Salesforce certification, so Audrey should not overstate engineering depth.

jobs.title: Operations Analyst
jobs.why: Very approachable experience requirement: 0-2 years, with new graduates encouraged. The role combines live operations, team coordination, troubleshooting, process improvement and lightweight automation, giving Audrey a credible path into broader technology operations.
jobs.gap: The job is five days per week on-site and includes financial reconciliation and marketplace risk work. SQL/Python are helpful, so Audrey should position her systems and automation strengths without claiming technical skills she does not have.

jobs.title: Gen AI Solutions & Operations Associate
jobs.why: Strong product/technology-operations bridge supporting a generative-AI platform. The role covers release execution, intake, servicing, access management, governance, status tracking and coordination across product, engineering and risk, and asks for 2+ years in operations, project management, product operations or related work.
jobs.gap: Technology governance, risk/control processes and AI-platform operations are newer domains for Audrey. Python, Tableau and Alteryx exposure would strengthen the application but should not be overstated.
